newsitem.title: USA: Colorado sells $200 million of TRANs.
newsitem.headline: Colorado sells $200 million of TRANs.

text.p: Colorado said it sold Tuesday $200 million of tax and revenue anticipation notes.
Bear Stearns won $100 million of the notes with a 4.50 percent coupon and 3.83050 percent net interest cost.
Prudential Securities won $25 million with a 4.50 percent coupon and 3.81550 percent yield.
Citicorp Securities won $25 million with a 4.50 percent coupon and 3.83050 percent net interest cost.
Lehman Brothers won $15 million with a 4.50 percent coupon and a 3.83050 percent net interest cost.
Norwest won $10 million with a 4.00 percent coupon and a 3.82744 percent net interest cost.
Zions won $10 million with a 4.50 percent coupon and a 3.82950 percent net interest cost.
Merrill Lynch & Co. won $5 million of the notes with a 4.50 percent coupon and a 3.83200 percent net interest cost.
Hanifen Imhoff won $5 million with a 4 percent coupon and a 3.79444 percent net interest cost.
And Zions also won $5 million of notes with a 4.50 percent coupon and a 3.81550 percent yield. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
